data.name: Factory Simulator
data.detailed_description:
ADD TO WHISTLIST


About the Game

🏭 Factory Simulator

Factory Simulator is a detailed production, automation, and management simulation where you build your factory from the ground up and control every step of the manufacturing process.

Start with simple machines, design efficient production lines, and gradually expand into a fully automated industrial facility. Every decision you make affects efficiency, profit, and growth.

Play solo or team up with friends in online co-op to manage production, logistics, and sales together.

🏗️ A Hands-On Factory Experience

Take full control of your factory operations. Handle materials, operate machines, manage storage, and oversee every stage of production.

Move boxes, place products on shelves, manage machine inputs and outputs, and organize your factory layout for maximum efficiency.

⚙️ Automation & Production Lines

Begin with basic systems and scale up to advanced automated workflows.
• Manage machine inputs and outputs
• Control storage and material flow
• Increase efficiency through smart automation

Well-planned systems can turn your factory into a self-sustaining production powerhouse.

🏪 Store & Sales Management

Sell your products directly through your factory store.

• Organize shelves and storage areas
• Set product prices
• Operate the checkout system
• Fulfill customer orders on time

Higher-quality production leads to happier customers and greater profits.

🚚 Logistics & Deliveries

Production doesn’t end at the factory floor.

• Manage warehouses and storage
• Prepare goods for shipment
• Handle deliveries and order fulfillment

Efficient logistics are essential to keeping your operation running smoothly.

👥 Single-Player & Online Co-op

Factory Simulator can be played solo or in online co-op.

Work together with friends to:
• Divide responsibilities
• Optimize workflows
• Scale production faster

Teamwork can be the key to building a successful factory.

🌍 Immersive 3D Environment

Experience factory management in a fully 3D, immersive environment.

Every machine, box, and workstation is part of a tangible, interactive system designed to feel grounded and realistic.

✨ KEY FEATURES

🏭 Build and manage a complete factory
⚙️ Design and optimize automated production lines
📦 Handle storage, logistics, and material flow
🏪 Operate a factory store with pricing and sales mechanics
🚚 Manage deliveries and order fulfillment
👥 Single-player and online co-op gameplay
🎮 System-driven, immersive simulation experience

🎯 Plan smart. Produce efficiently. Sell strategically.
In Factory Simulator, success comes from optimization, automation, and smart management.

👉 Add to your wishlist now and start building your industrial empire!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 4690 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 (1GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
